tickets.title: Ticket System
tickets.desc: Allow members to submit private reports and inquiries. Each ticket creates a private channel visible only to the submitter and your designated handler roles.
tickets.catChannelHint: New ticket channels will be created inside this category.
tickets.panelChannelHint: The channel where the ticket creation widget will appear.
tickets.noChannels: No text channels available. Create a channel under Structure first.
tickets.handlerRolesHint: Members with these roles can view and manage all tickets.
tickets.noRoles: No roles available yet. Create roles under Server Settings → Roles.
tickets.logChannelHint: Optional channel for ticket activity logs.
tickets.greetingHint: This message will be posted as the first message in every new ticket channel.
tickets.greetingPlaceholder: e.g. Thanks for reaching out! A staff member will be with you shortly.
tickets.categoriesHint: Define types/categories users can choose from when submitting a ticket.
tickets.customFieldsHint: Additional fields shown in the ticket submission form (beyond subject).
